behaviour: Home-page card content listing the signed-in user's latest unread notifications with deep links, severity, relative time and a mark-as-read action, refreshed by signals or by polling when signals are unavailable.
rules: 1. Declare and export UNREAD_NOTIFICATIONS_LIMIT = 5 and UNREAD_NOTIFICATIONS_POLLING_INTERVAL_MS = 60000, and a module-private SeverityLabelKeys = { critical: 'filters.severity.critical', high: 'filters.severity.high', normal: 'filters.severity.normal', low: 'filters.severity.low' } as const.
2. State: const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0); const refresh = useCallback(() => setRefreshKey(k => k + 1), []); isMounted = useMountedState() from 'react-use/esm/useMountedState'.
3. Fetch with useNotificationsApi from '../../hooks': api => api.getNotifications({ read: false, limit: UNREAD_NOTIFICATIONS_LIMIT, sort: 'created', sortOrder: 'desc' }), deps [refreshKey].

4. const { lastSignal, isSignalsAvailable } = useSignal<NotificationSignal>('notifications') from '@backstage/plugin-signals-react' (NotificationSignal from '@backstage/plugin-notifications-common'); useEffect on [lastSignal, refresh] calls refresh() when lastSignal?.action is truthy.

5. useEffect on [isSignalsAvailable, refresh]: when isSignalsAvailable is true return without a timer; otherwise const handle = setInterval(refresh, UNREAD_NOTIFICATIONS_POLLING_INTERVAL_MS) and return () => clearInterval(handle).

6. onMarkAsRead(id) (useCallback): notificationsApi.updateNotifications({ ids: [id], read: true }).then(() => { if (isMounted()) refresh(); }).catch(() => toastApi.post({ title: t('unreadNotificationsCard.markAsReadFailed'), status: 'danger' })); notificationsApi via useApi(notificationsApiRef) from '../../api', toastApi via useApi(toastApiRef) from '@backstage/frontend-plugin-api'.

7. Render order: if error -> <Text color="danger">{t('unreadNotificationsCard.errorMessage')}</Text>; else if loading and no value yet -> <Progress /> from '@backstage/core-components'; else if value.notifications is empty -> <Text color="secondary">{t('unreadNotificationsCard.emptyMessage')}</Text>; else the list. Keep showing the previous list while a refresh is loading.

8. List: <Flex direction="column" gap="3" role="list" aria-label={t('unreadNotificationsCard.title')}>; each item <Flex role="listitem" key={id} justify="between" align="center"> holding a column Flex (gap 1) and a ButtonIcon.

9. Title: <Text variant="body-medium"><Link to={`${notificationsRoute}?id=${encodeURIComponent(notification.id)}`}>{notification.payload.title}</Link></Text> with Link from '@backstage/core-components' and notificationsRoute = useRouteRef(rootRouteRef)() from '../../routes'.

10. Meta line: <Text variant="body-small" color="secondary"> containing <RelativeTime value={notification.created} /> (default import from 'react-relative-time' preceded by a // @ts-ignore line, as NotificationsTable does) and, only when payload.severity is set and not 'normal', ' • ' followed by t(SeverityLabelKeys[severity]).

11. Action: <ButtonIcon aria-label={t('unreadNotificationsCard.markAsRead')} icon={<RiCheckboxCircleLine size={16} />} variant="secondary" onPress={() => onMarkAsRead(notification.id)} />, ButtonIcon/Flex/Text from '@backstage/ui', icon from '@remixicon/react'.
12. Translate with useTranslationRef from '@backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha' and notificationsTranslationRef from '../../translation'; no literal user-visible string in the component.
13. UnreadNotificationsCardContent carries a /** @alpha */ TSDoc comment stating it is the content of the unread notifications home-page widget.

behaviour: jsdom tests for the card: listing, deep links, severity, mark as read, signal refresh, polling fallback with cleanup, empty and error states.
rules: 1. Render with renderInTestApp(<TestApiProvider apis={...}><UnreadNotificationsCardContent /></TestApiProvider>, { mountedRoutes: { '/notifications': rootRouteRef } }); rootRouteRef from '../../routes', notificationsApiRef from '../../api', toastApiRef from '@backstage/frontend-plugin-api', signalApiRef from '@backstage/plugin-signals-react'.

2. Notifications API mock: { getNotifications: jest.fn(), updateNotifications: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([]) }; toast mock { post: jest.fn() }; fixtures are Notification objects (id, user, created: new Date(), origin, payload { title, severity }) with ids 'n1' (severity 'high') and 'n2' (severity 'normal').

3. Signal API mock: { subscribe: jest.fn((_channel, onMessage) => { emit = onMessage; return { unsubscribe }; }) } where emit and unsubscribe = jest.fn() are per-test variables; omit signalApiRef from the providers to simulate signals being unavailable.

4. Fake-timer cases call jest.useFakeTimers() before rendering, wait for the first list with findByText, then advance with act(() => { jest.advanceTimersByTime(UNREAD_NOTIFICATIONS_POLLING_INTERVAL_MS); }); afterEach restores real timers.
5. Click the mark-as-read button with fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Mark as read' })[0]) and wait for removal with waitForElementToBeRemoved.
6. Use the exported constants for the limit and interval; no test ids.
